say:2:1320209001:1.text: That's her headstone alright. But... That old man seemed honest, so how is it that we were talking to Kliff earlier?
say:2:1320209001:1.source_cn: “她始终爱着未归来的丈夫，珀蒂”。\n的确是珀蒂的墓碑...

say:3:1320209002:1.text: I'm starting to think we've just been seeing things.
say:3:1320209002:1.source_cn: 我也渐渐开始不敢相信自己的眼睛了。

say:4:1320209003:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't we head back to the cabin?
say:4:1320209003:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't we head back to the cabin?
say:4:1320209003:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't we head back to the cabin?

say:5:1320209004:1.text: Yeah! It seems like there's been some kind of misunderstanding!
say:5:1320209004:1.source_cn: 是呢！也许这是个误会也说不定！
